title: MAQAC: code, per-mission results and videos for certified coordination of UAV aerial base stations
description: Simulator, MAQAC and all baseline coordination methods, AirSim/PX4 bridge, hardware-in-the-loop scripts, per-mission results and video demonstrations for the article "Certified Coordination of UAV Aerial Base Stations under Imperfect Perception and Backhaul Delay" (submitted to Vehicular Communications). See README.md.
